S.A.S. Dragon is built on the excellence of its human resources. Its richly experienced management team keeps in close touch with the latest industry and market trends . They are wholeheartedly committed to building, consolidating, maintaining, and improving client relationship, and have made S.A.S. Dragon a trusted and valued partner of suppliers and purchasers alike.

There are hundreds of sales and marketing team members in the Group. In China, it is tapping rapid economic growth by establishing offices in the fastest growing cities of the country, including Shenzhen, Shanghai, Beijing, Xiamen, Ningbo, Qingdao and Yan Tai. Sales and marketing teams are kept at the front line of product and market expertise. S.A.S Dragon maintains a strong international profile by regularly putting the products and services on display at major electronic products exhibitions around the world.

As our Group expands rapidly, we continuously seek high caliber and well-experienced people (from management, supervisory to support level) to be part of our team. If you are seeking a challenging job, we welcome you to join us. Attractive remuneration package including medical insurance, education allowance will be offered to the right candidate.
